## Summary

Aleks CP has 10+ years of experience building and operating production infrastructure. Core skills: Kubernetes, Terraform/OpenTofu, AWS, GCP, Linux, Docker, CI/CD, observability, and production operations.

Recent work includes:

- Leading the migration of core services from AWS to bare-metal infrastructure to reduce cloud costs and improve operational control.
- Owning infrastructure automation and microservices for DeFi backend platforms.
- Building and operating hosted AI agent and workflow automation systems for small teams, with the same monitoring, CI/CD, and maintenance discipline as production infrastructure.

Targeting roles: Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, SRE, and forward-deployed engineering roles that involve infrastructure or integrations.

## Services

### Secure self-hosted Hermes AI agent deployment
Full page: https://alekscp.com/services/hermes-agent-deployment/
Markdown: https://alekscp.com/services/hermes-agent-deployment/index.md

A packaged deployment of customer-owned Hermes Agent infrastructure on a VPS, cloud instance, or home server.

Scope:
- Server baseline: Ubuntu server setup, firewall defaults, fail2ban, unattended upgrades, restart-on-reboot behavior
- Hermes runtime: Hermes Agent installation, Docker Compose runtime, persistent data paths, generated configuration, verification checklist
- Messaging integration: Telegram gateway setup, optional Discord integration, allowed-user access control, provider/API key configuration
- Operations handoff: optional dashboard, Tailscale or reverse proxy access, simple backups, restore notes, handoff documentation

Security model: dashboard and API surfaces stay private unless public exposure is deliberately designed. Tailscale is the preferred private access path. A reverse proxy is added when a public domain, TLS, and access controls are required.

Good fit: founders, developers, small teams, and agencies that need self-hosted AI automation infrastructure with practical DevOps support.

Not the best fit: generic AI strategy, no-code-only automation, or enterprise management consulting without hands-on implementation work.

To request a quote, send: the VPS or hosting target, desired messaging gateway, LLM provider, dashboard preference, and the first workflow the agent should run. Contact: me@alekscp.com
